style.prompt: Design a polished vertical coffee poster with a premium cozy cafe aesthetic. Hero subject: a beautifully photographed ivory ceramic coffee cup filled with rich espresso and delicate crema, on a warm walnut surface, graceful wisps of steam rising above. Warm cream background, deep espresso brown typography, subtle caramel accents, soft morning side lighting, elegant shadows, refined editorial layout and generous negative space. Large beautifully typeset headline at top reads exactly 'GOOD DAYS START WITH COFFEE'. Small understated footer reads exactly 'Freshly brewed. Slowly enjoyed.' Cup prominently centered in lower middle, a few coffee beans near the base. Professional advertising poster, crisp readable lettering, tasteful minimal composition, no logos, no watermarks.
